result.finding: The application uses two communication protocols: HTTP/REST for client-facing API exposure (via Spring MVC) and JDBC over TCP for Oracle Database connectivity. No gRPC, message queues, WebSocket, or other inter-service protocols are used.
evidence: TodoController.java: @RestController and @RequestMapping("/api/todos") — HTTP REST API on port 8080
TodoController.java: 13 REST endpoints mapped (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
No RabbitMQ, Kafka, or messaging dependencies in pom.xml
No WebSocket or TCP/UDP socket usage found in source code
values: HTTP/REST (inbound): Spring MVC @RestController, port 8080, base path /api/todos
JDBC/TCP (outbound): Oracle JDBC Thin driver, host localhost, port 1521, service XEPDB1
HTTP methods used: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE
